Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.
